description: This Java class defines a generic DAO implementation for OpenMRS objects using Hibernate. It provides methods for retrieving, deleting, and saving objects by ID or UUID, utilizing Hibernate's SessionFactory.

classes.name: HibernateOpenmrsObjectDAO
classes.description: A generic DAO class for handling OpenMRS objects with Hibernate ORM, supporting CRUD operations by ID and UUID.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory used for database interactions.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an object of type T by its ID.

methods.name: getByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an object of type T by its UUID, using a utility method for UUID-based lookup.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the provided persistent object from the database.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates the provided persistent object in the database.
